subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native subagent runs expose parent-session progress streaming, and what child-output visibility/redaction contract should that stream use?
rationale: The code path is clear enough to implement, but choosing raw streaming, heartbeat-only status, or no native stream changes security boundaries and user-visible agent behavior.

options.title: Design redacted native progress first
options.body: Add an explicit bounded progress contract for native subagents before exposing any child tool output, then implement `streamTo="parent"` against that contract.

options.title: Keep completion-only native subagents
options.body: Leave native subagents as final-completion only and document ACP as the runtime for live parent streaming.

options.title: Mirror ACP streaming broadly
options.body: Expose child assistant/progress output to the parent with ACP-like behavior, accepting the higher leakage and routing-review burden.

recommendation.title: Design redacted native progress first
recommendation.body: Add an explicit bounded progress contract for native subagents before exposing any child tool output, then implement `streamTo="parent"` against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current tolerant sessions_spawn behavior that any product/security direction would need to preserve or replace.
